results.note: Circoloco stage with neon CIRCOLOCO letters and a big crowd under palms at sunset, Baba Beach Club Natai (2025 edition). 957 px is the largest version on the site. The dice and ticketmelon candidates were a red date graphic and a 424 px poster.

Pyramid stage at dusk: star-shaped bulb installation over the DJ booth and a packed crowd, from this event page's gallery. Portrait, but the subject survives a 16:9 centre crop. Converted from AVIF to JPEG. The candidate was an 'Announcing soon' text graphic.

Overhead view of the Pyramid DJ booth and crowd framed by palm fronds, from this event page's gallery. Portrait but crop-safe; converted from AVIF to JPEG. The Megatix and RA candidates were text flyers. A text-free official Marco Carola portrait (the page's og:image) is an alternative.

Fallback: official flyer key art from the ticket page (psychedelic footprint art, event text at top and bottom). Lost Jungle is a new venue's grand opening with no website; no venue or party photos on phangan.events, vibez.io, the Parvati Records site or web search. Chosen over the lineup-heavy phangan.events flyer.

OXA Oasis main stage at the Ban Tai jungle venue: thatched roofs, jungle plants, OXA arch and a crowd. Small OXA/Oasis tag top-left. Megatix candidates were text flyers. Used instead of Oasis-05, which events-oxa-jungle-party.jpg already uses.

Halfmoon's jungle main stage (Magic Forest): psychedelic canopy, A-frame stage, CO2 jets, big crowd. No logo overlay, unlike the larger VIP-page shots. Candidates were a text banner and a 2027 date chart.

The tribute act live on stage (helmeted performers, LIVE laser text, smoke jets, crowd), from its official site. The Megatix candidate was the flyer for the Bangkok show (Mustache, 16 Jan), not Phuket. No official photos of Banana Beach Club were found.
Daytime pool party at Barra Cuda, Patong: costumed performers, CO2 jets, crowd in the pool. The site's og:image is a 3D render and the Megatix images are AI-style flyers.

Night party at the Club SEEN stage: neon SEEN sign, fireworks, lasers, crowd. Exactly 16:9. A 'Defected' neon from a past event is visible. The Megatix images were AI-style flyers and a floorplan. The PNG is 4.4 MB.

Official MACAN tour key visual (singer performing, name in red, no dates); the site lists Phuket on the tour. lotusarena.com and the Art of Events site have no real photos of the arena. The Megatix flyer is text-heavy and says 08 Jan, SOLD OUT.

Spiritgust main-stage deco with dancers on the beach. This is the 8th edition (Dream Beach, Goa, 2023) from the official gallery, because the 2027 Tha Sala site is TBA. A small Lyserjunks mark bottom-right falls mostly outside a 16:9 crop. Text-free key art exists as an alternative (assets/brand/spiritgust-artwork-1920.webp).

Pyramid stage at night: lit A-frame, smoke, DJs and crowd, from Café del Mar's Pyramid gallery (shown on its 8 Jan Pyramid event page). Portrait but crop-safe; converted from AVIF to JPEG. The Carl Cox page's CO2-jets shot was skipped as near-identical to events-blondish-cafe-del-mar-2027.png. A text-free official Carl Cox portrait (the event page's og:image) is an alternative.
